official: 八王子市国民健康保険条例の一部を改正する条例設定について
committee: 予算等審査特別委員会
name: 国保税に子育て支援分を新設
summary: 現在の国民健康保険税は、基礎課税分、高齢者支援分、介護分などを組み合わせて計算しています。この議案では、新たに子ども・子育て支援分を設け、各区分の所得割率や1人あたりの額、低所得世帯などへの減額内容を改めます。令和8年4月1日に施行し、令和8年度分から適用します。
changes: 基礎課税分の所得割率を7.73%から7.42%、均等割額を1人44,000円から42,500円に改める
後期高齢者支援分の所得割率を2.83%から2.85%、均等割額を1人17,400円から17,800円に改め、介護分は所得割率を2.42%から2.41%、均等割額を1人18,800円から18,000円に改める
子ども・子育て支援分を新設し、所得割率を0.30%、加入者1人あたりの均等割額を1,800円、18歳以上の加入者1人あたりの額を100円とする
低所得世帯向けの減額額を改め、子ども・子育て支援分にも低所得世帯・未就学児・出産被保険者の減額を設ける
who: 八王子市の国民健康保険加入者

en.name: Adds a child and childcare support portion to national health insurance tax
en.official: Regarding the Establishment of an Ordinance Partially Amending the Hachioji City National Health Insurance Ordinance
en.summary: National health insurance tax is currently calculated by combining the basic portion, the support portion for older adults, the nursing care portion, and other portions. This bill creates a new child and childcare support portion and revises the income-based rates, per-person amounts, and reductions for low-income households and others in each portion. It takes effect on April 1, 2026, and applies from fiscal 2026.
changes: Revises the basic portion's income-based rate from 7.73% to 7.42% and its per-person amount from ¥44,000 to ¥42,500

Revises the older-adult support portion's income-based rate from 2.83% to 2.85% and its per-person amount from ¥17,400 to ¥17,800, and the nursing care portion's income-based rate from 2.42% to 2.41% and its per-person amount from ¥18,800 to ¥18,000
Creates a child and childcare support portion, with an income-based rate of 0.30%, a per-person amount of ¥1,800, and an amount of ¥100 per enrolled member aged 18 or older
Revises reductions for low-income households and introduces reductions in the child and childcare support portion for low-income households, preschool children, and insured people who give birth
who: People enrolled in Hachioji City's National Health Insurance
